## phr-p01-v03 — argument map

Sūtra 1: free consciousness causes the world's triple proving. Sūtra 2: by own will on own ground she opens the world (no borrowed means). Sūtra 3: manifoldness through fit perceiver-perceived division. Sūtra 4: contraction of consciousness — yet a knower, world-shrunk.

### Open
- viśvasiddhi gloss revised to triple process (vṛtti + Pradipaka); siddhi≠powers.
